substantive_difference: Dataclass visit holds token lease; Workspace composes concurrent.futures.Future delivery rather than subscriber/panel module handoff
lineage: Parent clean-room SemanticScopeBench pattern, with authored reentry/decode development extensions; this variant is not a new real issue.
environment_assumptions: Environment: one event loop, connect emits a bootstrap inline or queues a microtask; decode returns an immutable scalar value or once-fulfilled deferred result, with no rejection in this task. Immediate completions/publications remain synchronous. Publication may select/hide/reopen before connection/setup returns. Listener detachment is passive and skips removed not-yet-called listeners during dispatch. A transport may be reused and independent workspaces may share it. Accepted decode completions may finish in either order; there is no arrival-order latest-wins requirement. Framework unmount/native disposal maps to hide and invalidates output; no public methods are invoked after terminal disposal except harmless final hide.

mechanism_mapping.port_mapping: presence-listener-attached precedes bootstrap-emitted for synchronous and deferred delivery.

candidate_evidence_positions.excerpt: This workspace receives initial channel presence and subsequent updates. Sources may deliver during connection or after it. Channels can outlive a panel visit and be selected again. Host publication is an integration boundary that may synchronously navigate or hide. Decoding may complete immediately or later; removing reception does not retract an already-started decode. The metrics consumer deliberately excludes initial state. Public interfaces and payloads must remain compatible. Native host API spellings and dependencies are in docs/host-api.md.

The channel exposes connect(mode), emitUpdate(), target and decode(value). It emits immutable token:bootstrap or token:update values. Decode may complete now or later. Navigation exposes select(channel,mode), hide() and framework disposal. Publish(value,navigation) can synchronously navigate or hide. The independent metrics observer uses its own source and deliberately connects before attaching its listener, collecting updates only. Preserve these APIs and payloads.

Native counterparts use Channel.listen/detach/connect/update and Workspace.select/hide (Go exports Listen/Detach/Connect/Update/Select/Hide). Injected Environment supplies defer(callback), resolve(kind,key,scalar,completion) and output(kind,key,value); Java returns CompletableFuture<String>, Python concurrent.futures.Future, PHP uses Closure, Ruby blocks, Go typed funcs. Immediate completion executes inline; defer is controlled FIFO scheduling. Native channel emission/listener registry, subscription/visit state and publish decisions execute in the target runtime. The hidden wire only transports host calls/completions; it supplies no validity policy.

semantic_differences: JS ports retain native EventTarget/Promise. Native ports preserve scalar values and actual channel identity using ordered native callback subscriptions; injected FIFO defer replaces microtask enqueue. Java CompletableFuture/Python Future callbacks and PHP Closure/Ruby blocks/Go typed funcs keep immediate completion inline. Single-threaded callback semantics, no claim of arbitrary language/runtime equivalence.

independent_mutant_calibration_limits: Independent workspace isolation, reverse active completion and terminal unmount have positive controlled schedules; no separate mutant for every legal boundary.
Every parent obligation has targeted mutant or authorization counterfactual calibration; individual assertion failures are not independent obligation counts.
Publication eligibility and independent recoverability/oracle/difficulty reviews remain pending. No target model called.
No mutable payload snapshot, rejection, latest-wins ordering or multithread race is inferred from this parent.
observer_cleanup_difference: New metrics sources remove their own listener after collection finishes; this retains event values and collection completion. Parent observer has no corresponding final detachment requirement; no claim of original obligation added.

interface_mapping.createPresenceChannel: native Channel; JS same exported source API
interface_mapping.createWorkspaceNavigation: native Workspace / actual mounted Vue or React component / jQuery namespaced commands / ES module coordinator; select/hide semantics retained
interface_mapping.renderWorkspace: public combined result reconstructed by host from presence and independent collectMetrics; component ports expose imperative navigation instead of original panel factory exports
interface_mapping.decode: native Future/CompletionStage/block/Closure/typed func preserves inline and deferred scalar completion
interface_mapping.dispose: framework lifecycle cleanup or native hide; additional explicit boundary schedule
